# State Creative

> Independent Swedish studio for design, user experience, web development and consulting. Building products that make a difference — made in Sweden since 2011.

State Creative helps teams turn ideas into web and mobile products that feel simple and work beautifully, through consulting, technical work and hands-on development, always with the end user in mind.

## Services

- Design: identity, interface and visual design that is simple, considered and built to last.
- User experience: research, flows and prototypes that put real people at the centre of every decision.
- Web development: fast, accessible websites and web & mobile services, built with care from first line to launch.
- Consulting: technical guidance and hands-on help to plan, shape and ship digital products.

## Facts

- Founded: 2011
- Based in: Sweden
- Founder: Christopher State (https://cstate.se)
- Contact: hello@statecreative.se
